| **(2)** | Package performing HTTP delivery | **`github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`** (`/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go`). Async entry: **`PostAsync`**; actual HTTP: **`Post`**, using Go stdlib **`net/http`** via a package-level **`safeClient`** (`*http.Client` with SSRF-safe dial). Four init-time goroutines drain `asyncPostQueue` and call `Post`. No third-party webhook HTTP client appears in this path. |
| **(3)** | Request-signing mechanism | **Standard Webhooks–style HMAC-SHA256** (explicit in code comments). In **`Post`**: derive key via **`resolveSigningKey`** (`whsec_<base64>` secrets are base64-decoded; others used as raw bytes); sign `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + JSON body` with **`crypto/hmac` + `crypto/sha256`**; set headers **`webhook-id`** (`msg_<uuid>`), **`webhook-timestamp`** (Unix seconds), **`webhook-signature`** (`v1,<base64>`). Verified in `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook_test.go` (`TestPostSignsRequest`). |

---

### Note on comments

`CreateMemoComment` (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`) calls `CreateMemo` internally, so it also triggers `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` for the **comment author’s** webhooks. It additionally calls **`DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`** for the **parent memo owner’s** webhooks (`"memos.memo.comment.created"`). That is a separate event from plain memo creation.
